Oliver Wyman is seeking a Talent Manager to manage a population of ~60 consultants across Oliver Wyman’s offices and Practices. This role will be responsible for their scheduling and performance management, and for personally engaging with the consultants in your group to know and understand their strengths, development objectives, personal preferences and career goals. You will also interact with Partners and Talent Managers in other parts of the business to assemble consulting teams and to remediate any issues.

The successful Talent Manager will be able to proactively, delicately and empathetically balance the needs of the business alongside the preferences, career goals and development needs of the consultant to deliver appropriate staffing and talent management outcomes. You will work in a tight knit team against demanding timelines to help deliver Oliver Wyman’s business model.

This is a hybrid role that requires 3 days per week in the office. There is no option to be fully remote.

Key Responsibilities:

Talent Management:

  • Use the performance management process as a basis for engaging own consultants on development needs and areas for training
  • Develop relationships with each consultant and begin to be seen as a trusted advisor
  • Assist in directing consultants towards resources for career advice
  • Assist the consultants in escalating employee relations issues or questions around general Human Capital operations
  • Monitor for work-life-quality issues and escalate when needed
  • Collaborate with Human Capital Manager on managing the pyramid, training, onboarding, performance improvement initiatives

Project Staffing:

  • Understand at a high-level the nuances of the type of work / roles being filled
  • Liaise with project team leaders to understand staffing needs in your area
  • For assigned projects, collect all relevant details from Partners and Practice Group TMs on projects to be staffed
  • Anticipate capacity issues and manage consultants' and Partner expectations accordingly
  • Communicate staffing outcomes to consultants under your TM purview in an empathetic manner
  • Track mobility issues, holidays, trainings, background checks and other ad-hoc staffing enabling tasks
  • Ensure consultant files (bio slides, project reviews, technical skills, etc) are kept current and readily available for project proposals
  • Track your consultant’s performance, skills and development needs to help guide their growth and progression within OW

Consultant Development and Performance Management:

  • Understand the performance management framework and competency model and how it applies to own consultant's situations
  • Coordinate with the Learning and Development team on appropriate training for your consultants
  • Read all performance appraisals and follow-up any issues / performance flags with project team and manager
  • Coordinate, attend and contribute to annual Career Review meetings in for own consultant populations

Data, analysis and reporting:

  • Review weekly utilization reports, cross reference with the systems to ensure latest information is captured
  • Assist with the assembly of the project pipeline and consultant availability reports
  • Help to prepare documents and exhibits for various senior leadership meetings (using Excel and PowerPoint)
  • Assist with the analysis of performance outcome results
  • Ad hoc analyses and reporting as needed
  • Demonstrate capability in using enterprise resource management tools and performance systems
  • Maintain all employee records and keep resource planning systems up to date

Oliver Wyman Development:

  • Participate in project work within and adjacent to the broader Human Capital function on topics such as employee experience, retention, flexible working, utilization, performance, etc.
  • Organize own work and display ability to guide colleagues in building project deliverables
  • Work on cross-Practice Group, Market, Regional teams to deliver special / ad-hoc assignment in a collaborative manner
  • Be a firm citizen and embody Oliver Wyman values in day-to-day activities
  • Display a strong willingness to learn more about OW outside of the TM function by seeking out opportunities for broader involvement

Experience Required:

  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent work experience
  • 3-5 years of relevant professional experience in a fast-paced and dynamic client services business environment
  • Management consulting and/or Human Resources experience preferred

Skills and Attributes:

  • Proven ability to establish and grow relationships at all levels within an organization
  • Credible, highly professional, able to communicate and negotiate effectively while managing diverse personalities, cultures and backgrounds
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to tailor the message to fit the audience
  • Self-motivated and proactive; someone who takes full ownership of her/his work and is flexible to prioritize or reprioritize as needed
  • Comfortable working with data (excel, powerpoint and enterprise resource management software)
  • Creative, strategic thinker who continually seeks ways to improve processes
  • Genuinely interested in the development and career success of the consultants with whom you work
  • A strong attention to detail and high level of accuracy is required to juggle multiple projects and tasks simultaneously; as well as the ability to organize, prioritize and manage one’s day and schedule to effectively to meet deadlines
  • Comfortable working independently, but can thrive in a team setting; all while working in a fast-paced environment
  • English and Spanish Speaker

Oliver Wyman, a business of Marsh McLennan (NYSE: MMC), is a management consulting firm combining deep industry knowledge with specialized expertise to help clients optimize their business, improve operations and accelerate performance. Marsh McLennan is a global leader in risk, strategy and people, advising clients in 130 countries across four businesses: Marsh, Guy Carpenter, Mercer and Oliver Wyman. With annual revenue of $24 billion and more than 90,000 colleagues, Marsh McLennan helps build the confidence to thrive through the power of perspective. For more information, visit oliverwyman.com, or follow on LinkedIn and X.

Marsh McLennan is committed to creating a diverse, inclusive and flexible work environment. We aim to attract and retain the best people and embrace diversity of age, background, disability, ethnic origin, family duties, gender orientation or expression, marital status, nationality, parental status, personal or social status, political affiliation, race, religion and beliefs, sex/gender, sexual orientation or expression, skin color, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Marsh McLennan is committed to hybrid work, which includes the flexibility of working remotely and the collaboration, connections and professional development benefits of working together in the office. All Marsh McLennan colleagues are expected to be in their local office or working onsite with clients at least three days per week. Office-based teams will identify at least one “anchor day” per week on which their full team will be together in person.

Keeta, the international subsidiary of Meituan—the global delivery giant—is on a mission to revolutionize food and consumer product delivery worldwide. With our core belief: "We help people eat better, live better," we're taking innovation to the global stage!

2. Responsibilities

  • Team Building and Empowerment : Assist Keeta in establishing a food delivery sales team in new cities, starting from scratch to drive business expansion. Through systematic one-on-one or group training and empowerment models, rapidly enhance the team's capabilities and ensure the achievement of business goals.

  • Management Experience : Has experience in managing sales teams, with outstanding performance in another company over the past year.

  • Motivation and Resilience : Demonstrate strong ambition and professionalism, willingness to challenge oneself, and the ability to handle work-related pressure effectively.

Join us to witness the rapid growth of Meituan's global food delivery business and experience firsthand the industry transformation and growth miracles. You will collaborate with a world-class, diverse team, fostering innovative thinking, expanding your international perspective, and deepening your expertise. This is not just a job—it's an unparalleled opportunity to achieve personal growth, realize your self-worth, and drive global business innovation.

title: Project Analyst (Upstream)
description:
Project Analyst (Upstream)

Curitiba/PR, Brazil

Position type: Full-Time, in-person

Reports to: Regional Director, IPA-LA

Date posted: August 22, 2025

Closing date: Open until filled

Introduction

Are you interested in how the oil and gas Exploration & Production (E&P) world is transitioning? Do you love making connections and solving puzzles or problems? Are you detailed and focused, yet you also have broad interests and ideas and excellent communication skills? Do you enjoy analytical research work while also being comfortable client-facing?

If so, please apply as a Project Analyst – Petroleum Exploration & Production in IPA’s Latin America office! The Project Analyst will lead evaluations and consulting for major energy players to help them improve the effectiveness of their capital projects.

About the Role

Independent Project Analysis (IPA) has an opening position in our Latin America office (located in Curitiba/PR, Brazil) for a Project Analyst – Petroleum Exploration & Production . The candidate should have a proven track record working on capital projects or analyzing project feasibility in the upstream oil & gas market. Candidates are required to have strong analytical skills, intellectual curiosity, and a desire to contribute as a thought leader. Aptitude for and demonstrated skills to be a successful analyst include your ability to connect in real life with the data and vice versa, to know when to ask more questions and when to just listen, as well as to be self-motivated to learn and thrive.

IPA’s client portfolio includes world-leading companies in both the heavy and light industries around the world. IPA has offices in the United States, the United Kingdom, The Netherlands, Australia, Brazil, and Singapore; as such, major industry leaders globally rely on us to assess the health of their capital project systems and provide recommendations to improve their performance. IPA evaluates hundreds of capital projects every year, developing very complete technical, business, and people histories from their front-end through early operation. These histories become the data we use to find what works and what does not work in capital projects. The IPA project databases are unique and the most comprehensive sources of capital project experience in existence. IPA also takes a leading role in empirical research into the drivers of better projects and project systems using our extensive databases of past project performance.

Responsibilities

General responsibilities of the role include:

  • Working directly with capital project teams and project organizations of major E&P companies to improve business competitiveness
  • Interfacing with clients to collect and analyze technical, cost, schedule, and project management data
  • Writing reports with insight and a customer focus
  • Delivering verbal feedback and public presentations
  • Conducting research on the drivers of project success or failure using proprietary databases and statistics

Day in the Life

Responsibilities of the Project Analyst – Petroleum Exploration & Production role include:

  • Interfacing directly with clients in person to collect project data and uncover areas of risk
  • Applying statistical analysis to quantify your findings
  • Writing reports to provide insight and recommendations for clients
  • Delivering verbal feedback and presentations to technical and business audiences
  • Working directly with capital project teams and project organizations of major E&P companies to improve business competitiveness
  • Conducting research on drivers of project success and failure using IPA’s proprietary databases and statistics

Skills and Qualities

Project Analysts – Petroleum Exploration & Production must have:

  • Demonstrable Portuguese and English language oral and written communication skills; fluency in Spanish is an advantage
  • Solid analytical skills
  • Ability to demonstrate intellectual curiosity and organizational leadership
  • Excellent listening, presentation, and report writing skills with strong attention to detail
  • Strong interpersonal skills to develop and maintain relationships at senior levels with client companies and liaise with people from other cultures
  • Strong work ethic
  • High self-motivation and ability to work independently
  • Positive attitude and willingness to work in a team
  • Ability to work to tight deadlines and under pressure
  • Flexibility in taking on a variety of assignments

Travel

  • This position requires up to 30 percent travel; candidates are required to have proper documentation for necessary business travel
  • Travel will be required primarily within Latin America and is primarily on weekdays

Education and Experience

  • A Master’s degree (preferred) or Bachelor’s degree or the equivalent in engineering, science (physics, chemistry, petroleum, geology), statistics, operations research, economics, or related fields
  • Minimum of 3 years of relevant experience with upstream oil and gas projects
  • Proven record of carrying out independent research or using a variety of statistical methods to analyze large amounts of data

WHY IPA?

For over 35 years, IPA has delivered groundbreaking research and quantitative risk analyses to enhance the value generated by our clients’ capital project systems and meet their obligations for sustainable and safe performance. IPA guides capital‑intensive organizations to establish the right combination of people, work process, and governance to maximize performance across several measures: cost, schedule, safety, operability performance, and carbon reduction. We have a dataset of over 24,000 capital projects as the basis of our work. Our clients are leading companies in the energy, minerals, infrastructure, chemicals, pharmaceutical, and consumer products sectors. IPA is committed to social and ethical responsibility, and all global offices initiate or participate in local charity initiatives to support those in need .

HOW TO APPLY

Applicants should complete the form at and include a cover letter, resume, and salary requirement.

title: Senior Project Engineer
description:
Company Summary

Recurrent Energy is a wholly owned subsidiary of Canadian Solar Inc. and is one of the world's largest and most geographically diversified utility-scale solar and energy storage project development, ownership, and O&M platforms. Recurrent Energy is focused on bringing low-cost clean energy and meaningful economic development to communities across the globe.


At Recurrent Energy, we believe in the power of teamwork to create a sustainable future. Join us as we work together toward a cleaner, greener tomorrow.


Position Title:
 Senior Project Engineer

Department:
 Engineering & Construction

Reports To :
Sr. Manager, Project Engineering

Location :
Flexible hybrid model from our offices in São Paulo. In addition, traveling may be required to project sites.


Position Summary:

Recurrent Energy is comprised of an innovative, passionate, and hard-working team that is committed to making a difference and transforming the world with clean electricity. People are what make the company stand out. As a Senior Project Engineer, you demonstrate the perfect combination of technical expertise and project management savvy.


You will lead the development, coordination and review of designs and technical standards for Recurrent Energy’s utility scale solar and BESS projects. At the core, as a Project Engineer you are an expert coordinator, bringing together stakeholders of every level for effective and profitable project deliveries.


Responsibilities

  • Lead technical oversight during design and construction, ensuring value-engineered solutions that meet project specifications and enhance system performance.
  • Drive technical excellence and provide supervision for the design and construction phases of the project.
  • Lead and oversee engineering service providers, ensuring compliance with project requirements and standards.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless project execution and delivery.
  • Establish, maintain, and improve technical specifications for Recurrent Energy facilities and equipment.
  • Mentor and guide junior engineers, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and innovation.
  • Provide engineering and QA/QC support to the project management team during project construction and commissioning.
  • Attend factory acceptance tests for HV and electrical equipment, as needed
  • Evaluation of PV products, emerging technologies and best practices in the solar EPC field.
  • Ensure adherence to IEEE standards, EPC contract, Interconnection Agreement (IA) and Power Purchase Agreement (PPA) /interconnection requirements.
  • Refine procedures for the interface between development and engineering as well as between project managers and engineering.


Qualifications

To perform this job successfully, an individual will perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.


  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering or related field;
    Master's degree preferred.
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in utility-scale solar and BESS project engineering.

Are you a hands-on professional with a passion for precision and performance? Join us in delivering high-quality MEP systems for landmark projects in the UAE.

Who we are!

ALEC Engineering and Contracting L.L.C. (ALEC), part of ICD, is a leading GCC construction company known for delivering complex, high-profile projects. With 20+ years of experience, ALEC builds across sectors including airports, hospitality, retail, and high-rises


In the UAE, ALEC has delivered many of the nation’s most iconic developments, operating as a fully integrated contractor through specialist business units that provide end-to-end construction solutions.


ALEMCO provides integrated MEP and facilities services that power some of the region’s most ambitious developments. From electrical systems to long-term maintenance, we focus on technical reliability and sustainable performance - supported by an inclusive and skilled team with a passion for engineering excellence.


Why Join Us?

As a BIM Modeler, you’ll play a pivotal role in transforming design information into precise 3D models and construction documents. You’ll support our field operations with shop drawings, schedules, and coordinated data, driving project accuracy and collaboration forward.


At ALEMCO, we’re about more than just building iconic structures - we’re about building exceptional careers. As a trusted partner to some of the region’s most ambitious projects, we value innovation, operational excellence, and our people. Join us to deliver Project Planning and Controls initiatives that directly shape our business success, from sourcing candidates to enhancing candidate experiences.


Your Role

  • Review tender and IFC information (2D drawings, BIM models, asset data) per ISO19650 standards
  • Create and maintain Revit-based BIM models, including GA plans, sections, diagrams, and schedules
  • Perform clash detection and support clash avoidance coordination
  • Maintain clean, healthy BIM models following industry best practices
  • Update and revise models/documents based on RFIs, design changes, and site instructions
  • Identify inconsistencies in contract documents and flag them appropriately
  • Assist with as-built documentation and handover preparation
  • Work collaboratively in shared environments (CDE), supporting both internal and external teams
  • Follow project standards, templates, protocols, and document control procedures
  • Provide accurate technical responses to site queries and requests


What We’re Looking For

  • Technical Diploma in Architecture, Civil or Mechanical Engineering
  • Minimum 3 years of BIM experience on construction projects
  • Proficient in Revit and AutoCAD
  • Familiarity with CDE platforms and coordination tools (Revizto, Navisworks)
  • Basic knowledge of Microsoft Office and Adobe Acrobat
  • Understanding of BIM principles and workflows
  • Strong written and spoken English skills


What We Offer

  • Total package of salary, UAE Employment Visa, Medical Insurance & Annual ticket allowance.
  • The chance to contribute to some of the UAE's most iconic projects.
  • A collaborative, supportive environment that values innovation and excellence.
  • Opportunities for professional growth and career progression.


Ready to Lead?

If you’re inspired by what you’ve read and believe you’re the right fit, we’d love to hear from you.

Join ALEMCO and shape the future of infrastructure delivery in the UAE.


Apply today and be part of something extraordinary.

title: Project Manager
description:
Project Manager | UAE


Are you a results-driven leader with a proven track record in delivering high-value, mission-critical construction projects?


This role is based on-site in the UAE and will require relocation. ALEC will be holding interviews in the following cities.

  • Sau Paulo, Brazil
  • Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
  • Bogota, Columbia


Who We are?

ALEC Holdings L.L.C - S.O. (ALEC), part of ICD, is a leading GCC construction company known for delivering complex, high-profile projects. With 20+ years of experience, ALEC builds across sectors including airports, hospitality, retail, and high-rises.


In the UAE, ALEC has delivered many of the nation’s most iconic developments, operating as a fully integrated contractor through specialist business units that provide end-to-end construction solutions.


ALEC Building forms the structural heart of the Group, delivering high-value construction projects from foundation to finish. Whether commercial towers or luxury hospitality developments, we build safely, collaboratively, and with precision, laying the groundwork for long-term success.


Why Join Us?

In the role of Project Manager , you’ll take ownership of high-value digital infrastructure projects from initiation to handover. ALEC Data Centre Solutions combines speed, security, and technical precision and you’ll be leading teams that deliver mission-critical environments trusted by global tech leaders.


At ALEC, we’re about more than just building world-class facilities—we’re about building exceptional careers. As a trusted partner to some of the region’s most ambitious developments, we value innovation, operational excellence, and our people. Join us and lead delivery efforts that shape the region’s digital future.


About Your Team

This role reports directly to the Operations Director and is part of the ALEC Data Centre Solutions core delivery team. The project delivery function oversees execution, programme coordination, stakeholder engagement, and quality control across all phases of construction. The team works closely with Planning, Commercial, Procurement, QA/QC, HSE, and Site Operations to ensure flawless execution.


Your Role

As a Project Manager , you will:

  • Lead the overall planning, coordination, and execution of data centre construction projects, ensuring alignment with budget, quality, and schedule targets.
  • Manage internal teams and external stakeholders to ensure project milestones are achieved.
  • Develop detailed execution strategies and monitor risk, procurement, and resource plans.
  • Ensure compliance with health, safety, and environmental (HSE) regulations.
  • Oversee reporting, performance tracking, and contractual obligations.
  • Coordinate technical reviews, design validations, and issue resolution.
  • Manage change controls and support commercial teams in claims and EOT matters.


What We’re Looking For

  • Experience:
     10+ years of project management experience, preferably in complex construction or mission-critical environments (e.G., data centres, hospitals, infrastructure).
  • Knowledge:
     Deep understanding of construction lifecycles, contract management, planning tools, and client engagement.
  • Expertise:
     Ability to lead multi-disciplinary teams, control budgets, and manage fast-track delivery.
  • Proficiency in Primavera P6, MS Project, and Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
  • Strong leadership, communication, and reporting skills.
  • Degree in Engineering or a related discipline.
  • PMP certification is an advantage.
  • Resilient, hands-on, and capable of leading under pressure.


What We Offer

· The chance to contribute to some of UAE most iconic projects.

· A collaborative, supportive environment that values innovation and excellence.

· Opportunities for professional growth and career progression.


Ready to plan the path to project success?

If you’re inspired by what you’ve read and believe you’re the right fit, we’d love to hear from you.

Join ALEC and play a pivotal role in shaping a high-performing team that drives our success.


Apply today and be part of something excellent!

A área é responsável pela análise detalhada de internações (eletivas e de urgência), procedimentos, materiais e medicamentos. Ela serve como ponto de contato entre clientes, ouvidoria, prestadores e beneficiários.

É essencial que a área execute as ações de forma eficiente, buscando melhorias e otimizações. O acompanhamento de indicadores de desempenho é crucial para guiar as atividades.

A área também propõe mudanças, analisa o perfil das solicitações e concilia a gestão de sinistros com a experiência do cliente.

Realizar apoio técnico, estimular o conhecimento e instaurar o inconformismo;

Garantir que as mudanças propostas considerem o impacto na jornada do cliente, buscando soluções que tornem o processo de sinistro mais transparente, ágil e menos burocrático;

Buscar um equilíbrio entre a eficiência na gestão de custos de sinistros e a qualidade do serviço prestado ao cliente, evitando que medidas de redução de custos comprometam a experiência do cliente;

Acompanhar os resultados das mudanças implementadas, avaliando seu impacto nos indicadores de sinistro e na satisfação do cliente, e realizar ajustes conforme necessário;

Avaliar e propor a adoção de novas tecnologias e ferramentas que possam otimizar a gestão de sinistros e melhorar a experiência do cliente;

title: Cloud Data Engineer
description:
JOB SUMMARY

Responsible for designing and implementing robust data pipelines. Must maintain high data quality and security in cloud environments, automating tasks with Python and Bash scripting, and continuously research new technologies to enhance scalability. This role focuses on the development and implementation of data engineering solutions that enhance data warehousing capabilities and maintain legacy and new systems.


DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Design and implement data pipelines to move and transform data from various sources into cloud-based data warehouses.
  • Develop and maintain ETL processes using tools such as Fivetran, Matillion, SSIS, SSAS, SSRSand Snowflake Dataflow on AWS.
  • Optimize data storage and retrieval by designing and implementing data partitioning, indexing, and compression strategies.
  • Build and maintain data processing infrastructure on cloud platforms such as AWS.
  • Collaborate with business and analysts to ensure data quality, accuracy, and availability for analysis and reporting.
  • Manage and lead Complex System Design, Integration and Development.
  • Monitor and troubleshoot data pipelines and infrastructure to ensure high availability and performance.
  • Implement security and access controls to protect sensitive data in cloud-based environments.
  • Automate data processing tasks using scripting languages such as Python or Bash
  • Research and evaluate new technologies and tools to improve data processing efficiency and scalability.
  • Mentor and train junior data engineers and provide technical guidance to cross-functional teams.
  • Perform other job-related functions as assigned.



QUALIFICATIONS

DEGREE TYPE:

Bachelor's Degree

FIELD(S) OF STUDY:

Computer Science, Engineering or related field


EXPERIENCE

  • Minimum of 4 years’ experience developing, validating, and implementing data warehouses, data systems or cloud-based data solutions.
  • Experience in data engineering with a focus on data warehousing and legacy systems.
  • Experience with multiple data modeling approaches, SQL, and scripting programming languages like Python and PowerShell.


COMPETENCIES/SKILLS

  • Good understanding of OLAP Cubes, Dimensional model.
  • Ability to lead and coach team members.
  • Strong communication skills and stakeholder engagement abilities;
    driving results throughinnovation, process improvement and creativity.
  • Able to prioritize and execute tasks in a high-pressure, fast-paced environment.
  • Demonstrated understanding of agile methodologies, QA practices and user experience, with strong digital & technical skills.
  • Experienced with collaboration tools (Jira, Confluence, Lucid Chart;
    ).
  • Strong understanding of databases such as Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle, MySQL, HANA, Snowflake.
  • Experience with traditional on-prem virtual and physical infrastructure, as well as cloud-based environments, preferably AWS.
  • Excellent understanding of Windows, and Linux based infrastructure.
  • Working knowledge of various tools, open-source technologies, and cloud services

Your work will ensure that our designs are clearly communicated, compliant with regulations, and efficiently executed on site.


At ALEC, we’re about more than just building world-class facilities, we’re about building exceptional careers. As a trusted partner to some of the region’s most ambitious developments, we value innovation, operational excellence, and our people. Join us and lead delivery efforts that shape the region’s digital future.


Your Role

  • Prepare detailed architectural and structural drawings for building construction projects.
  • Develop general arrangement (GA) drawings, foundation plans, sections, elevations, and detail drawings.
  • Support the design team by translating conceptual sketches and technical data into accurate CAD drawings.
  • Collaborate on the development of structural layouts, floor plans, and utility networks.
  • Update and revise designs based on feedback from engineers, architects, or site observations.
  • Ensure all drawings comply with local building codes, design standards, and project specifications.
  • Maintain organized and version-controlled drawing files within the design department.
  • Coordinate with other disciplines (electrical, mechanical) to ensure design integration and conflict resolution.

  • Familiarity with Revit, Civil 3D, or other BIM software is advantageous.

  • Experience with local authority drawing submissions and approval processes.
  • Bachelor's in Civil Engineering / Drafting Technology or equivalent.
  • Proven experience as a draughtsman in the building construction or architectural design industry.
  • High proficiency in AutoCAD;
    Revit, Civil 3D, or other BIM tools are a strong advantage.
  • Good understanding of civil and structural design principles and building systems.
  • Strong ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and specifications.
  • Excellent attention to detail and commitment to quality.
  • Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple design tasks simultaneously.


What We Offer

· The chance to contribute to some of UAE most iconic projects.

· A collaborative, supportive environment that values innovation and excellence.

· Opportunities for professional growth and career progression.


Ready to plan the path to project success?

If you’re inspired by what you’ve read and believe you’re the right fit, we’d love to hear from you.

Join ALEC and play a pivotal role in shaping a high-performing team that drives our success.


Apply today and be part of something excellent!

description:

Nosso objetivo é simplificar o processo de pagamento, tornando-o mais rápido, mais seguro e mais eficiente, ao mesmo tempo em que proporcionamos uma experiência de usuário excepcional.

Buscamos uma pessoa com perfil proativo, analítico e com vontade de liderar a fim de transformar cada vez mais a experiência dos nossos cliente, em um ambiente integrado com negócios e apoiando o time na condução das atividades do dia-a-dia.


O que você precisa para ser um Ituber?

Estamos buscando pessoas que queiram se desenvolver e aprender constantemente, compartilhando, colaborando, inovando e entregando valor para todos os nossos clientes. Aqui a gente não sabe tudo, a gente vai de turma

- Definir soluções de plataforma

- Analisar requisitos de sistema e negócios

- Implementar estratégias de redução de custos de plataformas (FinOps)

- Conhecer desenvolvimento em plataformas Java ou Python

- Conhecimento de testes unitários, testes integrados, testes funcionais e testes automatizados

- Trabalhar com a ferramentas Git

- Conhecimento do fluxo de integração contínua e deploy contínuo.

- Execução de code-reviews

- Conhecimento de práticas de desenvolvimento Ágil, DevOps e Infraestrutura

- Conhecimento em AWS

- Entender o produto de débito automático

- Atuar em conjunto com outras pessoas engenheiras no desenho de soluções modernas, escaláveis, seguras e resiliente


No que você precisa mandar bem?

  • Conhecimentos sólidos em Java e/ou Python
  • Conhecimentos sólidos em serviços da Amazon Web Services (AWS)
  • Conhecimentos em serviços de filas e mensageria (RabbitMQ, Kafka, SQS, SNS)
  • Conhecimentos sólidos em bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais (DynamoDB, Redis, SQL Server)

title: Especialista Fiscal
description:
O Especialista Fiscal será responsável por garantir a correta apuração de tributos indiretos, bem como a elaboração e transmissão das obrigações acessórias, assegurando o cumprimento da legislação tributária. Atuará na interpretação de normas, análise e conciliação de contas contábeis relacionadas a tributos, além de revisar processos fiscais e propor melhorias. Seu foco será manter a conformidade fiscal, reduzir riscos e apoiar as áreas internas com orientações técnicas, contribuindo para a eficiência e segurança tributária da empresa.


Principais responsabilidades:

  • Atuar como referência técnica na interpretação e aplicação da legislação tributária, acompanhando alterações e avaliando impactos para a empresa.
  • Realizar e revisar apuração de tributos indiretos (ICMS, ICMS-ST, IPI, ISS, PIS, COFINS, PCC).
  • Elaborar, revisar e transmitir obrigações acessórias complexas (EFD Fiscal, EFD Contribuições, EFD-Reinf, DCTF, DeSTDA, FCI, entre outras).
  • Conduzir análises e conciliações de contas contábeis relacionadas a tributos, propondo soluções para inconsistências.
  • Desenvolver melhorias contínuas nos processos fiscais para otimizar tempo, reduzir riscos e garantir compliance.
  • Apoiar a gestão com relatórios gerenciais, pareceres técnicos e análises estratégicas.
  • Assegurar conformidade fiscal nos sistemas corporativos (SAP Business One – vivência obrigatória).

Requisitos obrigatórios:

  • Ensino Superior completo em Ciências Contábeis ou Administração.
  • Mínimo de 5 anos de experiência na área Fiscal em nível Pleno ou Sênior.
  • Conhecimento avançado em legislação tributária e regimes Lucro Real, Presumido e Simples Nacional.
  • Excel avançado e experiência prática em relatórios gerenciais.
  • Vivência obrigatória com SAP Business One.

Diferenciais:

  • Especialização em legislação tributária ou áreas correlatas.
  • Perfil analítico, proatividade e habilidade para atuar de forma consultiva com diferentes áreas da empresa.

Local e regime de trabalho:

  • Votorantim/SP – Modelo híbrido.
  • Horário:
    Segunda a quinta-feira, das 08h às 18h, e sexta-feira, das 08h às 17h.
  • Salário:
     A combinar (informe sua pretensão salarial na candidatura)


  • Benefícios:
     Cartão Caju (multibenefício), convênio médico Unimed, convênio odontológico, vale-transporte, alimentação no local, PPR, TotalPass.


Se você busca um desafio técnico de alto nível na área Fiscal e quer atuar em uma empresa que valoriza inovação, qualidade e segurança tributária, esta vaga é para você!


Candidate-se e faça parte da nossa equipe.

title: Gerente Enfermagem Hospitalar
description:
Objetivo:


Responsável pela gestão do serviço de enfermagem, garantindo a qualidade do atendimento, segurança do paciente e eficiência operacional, alinhando as práticas de enfermagem com as políticas e diretrizes da operadora de saúde.


Alcançar resultados organizacionais positivos e sustentáveis, por meio da gestão de processos assistenciais e administrativos, com o uso racional dos recursos materiais envolvidos e desenvolvimento integral e contínuo das equipes profissionais, no que tange ao escopo dos serviços de enfermagem.


Estabelecer uma estratégica, ética, humanizada e transformacional, fortalecendo a cultura de excelência no atendimento e cuidado ao paciente/família.


Responsabilidades:


  • Participar das definições de diretrizes mínimas nos processos assistenciais, baseadas na prática baseada em evidência, direcionadas pela melhor qualidade assistencial, menor custo e melhor experiência do paciente e sustentadas por padrões e protocolos assistenciais;
  • Apoiar na implantação das práticas assistenciais definidas e validadas, conforme planejamento nos Hospitais;
  • Acompanhar o desempenho das funções técnicas dos times de enfermagem nas unidades de negócio (Centro Cirúrgico, CME e Hemodinâmica) com valor agregado, utilizando diferentes ferramentas para intervenções necessárias nos processos de enfermagem, gerenciamento dos protocolos assistenciais por meio dos indicadores de processos e resultados, com planos de ação que sustentem a excelência dos serviços com custo eficiência;
  • Garantir o cumprimento dos processos de gestão de pessoas, garantindo o engajamento, treinamentos, bem-estar, inclusão e diversidade do time de enfermagem;
  • Assegurar com disciplina o Headcount de Enfermagem com o dimensionamento alinhado as regulamentações/demanda nos diferentes macroprocessos;
  • Assegurar eficiência nos custos variáveis pela melhor padronização dos materiais médicos;
  • Cumprir as diretrizes que contemplem e zelem pelas normas legais e princípios éticos e que sejam cumpridos na unidade hospitalar;
  • Gerenciar açõesmultidisciplinares de padrões e protocolos acordados com a Diretoria de Enfermagem;
  • Gerenciar, apoiar e participar ativamente da Implementação dos protocolos de prevenção de riscos;
  • Acompanhar e reportar indicadores de qualidade, avaliando desempenho e resultado com definição de planos de ação;
  • Realizar a análise crítica dos resultados assistenciais do hospital;
  • Cumprir e respeitar as normas e regras instituídas pela empresa, bem como, as regras dos órgãos certificadores adotados por esta instituição.



Acompanhamento de Performance:


  • Indicadores de Pessoas (turnover, absenteísmo, pesquisa de engajamento, participação em treinamentos);
  • Indicadores de Qualidade;
  • Indicadores de processo e resultado nos macroprocessos ((Pronto Socorro, Unidades de Internação, UTIs, Centro Cirúrgico, CME e Unidades Ambulatórias/Medicina diagnóstica e setores afins);
  • NPS – Pesquisa de experiencia do paciente e colaborador.



Requisitos:


Formação obrigatória:


Graduação de Enfermagem com COREN ativo.

Pós-graduação em áreas afins

Desejáveis:


Pós-graduação / MBA em áreas relacionadas à gestão de serviços de saúde, administração hospitalar, gestão em enfermagem, negócios em saúde, dentre outras afins.

Experiência em processos de acreditação hospitalar ou projetos de melhoria da qualidade do cuidado e segurança do paciente.

Diferenciais:


Formação em gestão de pessoas e equipes e/ou gestão da qualidade em saúde.

Capacitação em comunicação interpessoal em saúde.

Vivência profissional em atividades de gestão da experiência do paciente.

title: Analista Carga Horaria Sr
description:
Somos o grupo educacional mais diversificado do país. Todos os dias, criamos futuros incríveis através da inovação. Colocamos a mão na massa para tirar as ideias do papel e colocá-las em prática. Enfrentamos desafios com resiliência e nos adaptamos às mudanças constantes.


Por aqui, somos um time e não heróis, guiados pela vontade de fazer a diferença e conectados de um só jeito, o #JeitoCogna. Nossa relação é direta e respeitosa, e o sucesso dos nossos alunos e clientes é o nosso sucesso.


Além disso, valorizamos a diversidade, porque sabemos que quanto mais diverso é o nosso repertório, mais abrangente e inclusivo seremos. Juntos impulsionamos as pessoas a construírem uma melhor versão de si! E aí, bora fazer parte da empresa líder absoluta do segmento educacional? Vem pra Cogna.


Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Fazer a gestão do orçamento de todos os docentes da companhia, considerando professores, tutores e preceptores;
  • Atuar no planejamento acadêmico, sendo responsável por mapear a oferta de disciplinas de cada semestre e calcular a carga horária que gerará custo docente;
  • Construir e acompanhar o orçamento da área, respeitando as diretrizes acadêmicas e garantindo a aderência ao planejado;
  • Monitorar o plano orçamentário, entendendo e atuando sobre possíveis desvios e ajustes ao longo do período;
  • Realizar análises de viabilidade financeira, com trocas constantes com as áreas de finanças, unidades e times acadêmicos;
  • Trabalhar com grandes volumes de dados, utilizando ferramentas como Python e banco de dados para gerar análises robustas e complexas;
  • Comunicar estratégias, resultados e análises de forma clara para públicos diversos, apoiando também na condução de treinamentos e capacitações internas;
  • Gerenciar projetos voltados à otimização de processos e eficiência operacional.

Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Ensino superior completo;
  • Experiência sólida em planejamento, orçamento e análise de dados;
  • Domínio de ferramentas analíticas, como Python, Excel avançado e banco de dados;
  • Raciocínio lógico e visão estratégica;
  • Boa comunicação, capacidade de apresentar resultados e apoiar treinamentos;

    Especialização em Otimização de Processos, Certificação em Gestão de Projetos, experiência prévia em ambiente educacional.


O que buscamos:

  • Perfil com forte viés numérico e capacidade analítica;
  • Proatividade para lidar com cenários complexos e mudanças no planejamento;
  • Facilidade paratrabalhar de forma colaborativa com diferentes áreas da organização;
  • Comprometimentocom a entrega de resultados e melhoria contínua.

Modelo de trabalho híbrido (3x na semana presenciais);

Temos alguns escritórios espalhados pelo Brasil, mas você ficará alocado em São Paulo (Av. Paulista).


O que você pode esperar da gente?

    num cartão de benefícios flexível.

Aqui, acreditamos no respeito, na diversidade e na busca da inclusão em todas suas frentes. Todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados independentemente de raça, gênero, identidade, expressão de gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, genética, deficiência ou de qualquer outra base.

title: Site Manager
description:
We're Hiring:
Site Managers – Interior Fit-Out Experts for High-End Projects in KSA & UAE


ALEC FITOUT, a division of ALEC Holdings and part of the Investment Corporation of Dubai (ICD), is a leading specialist in high-end interior fit-out and refurbishment projects across luxury hospitality, cultural, and themed entertainment sectors. We bring visionary interiors to life through precision execution and world-class craftsmanship.


ALEC FITOUT is seeking a Site Manager who will lead the execution of fit-out works on-site from planning and progress monitoring to quality assurance, HSE compliance, and subcontractor coordination. You’ll ensure timely, cost-effective, and high-quality delivery of luxury interiors in collaboration with project stakeholders.


  • Please note that this role may be assigned to ALEC FITOUT projects located either in Saudi Arabia (KSA) or United Arab Emirates, (UAE).
  • The position requires a six-day working week , which is mandatory for all site-based roles.
  • Successful candidates must be eligible to obtain a work visa for either KSA or UAE.


Your Role:

  • Lead the on-site execution of interior fit-out works from start to handover.
  • Coordinate with subcontractors, consultants, and in-house teams to maintain schedule and quality.
  • Oversee daily site activities, progress tracking, and reporting.
  • Ensure compliance with HSE, QA/QC, and client expectations.
  • Manage subcontractor performance and support variation/claim documentation.
  • Mentor and guide the construction team to maintain a high-performance culture.


What You’ll Need:

  • Degree/Diploma in Civil Engineering or related field.
  • 10+ years' construction experience, with at least 5 years in interior fit-out.
  • Expertise in managing luxury fit-out projects (hospitality, commercial, retail, or residential).
  • Strong leadership and coordination skills on fast-paced interior sites.
  • Deep understanding of interior finishes, sequencing, and subcontractor scopes.
  • Fluent in English


Core Technical Skills:

  • Interior Fit-Out Execution
  • Project Scheduling & Planning
  • Site Management & Supervision
  • Progress Monitoring & Reporting
  • HSE & Quality Assurance
  • Technical Drawing & Method Statement Review


Please ensure to attach your CV in English when applying.

Are you obsessed about ensuring customers get the best out of the technology?

Do you enjoy helping customers to optimally use the product?

As Customer Success Manager and Solution Consultant for the South America region, you'll play a pivotal role in driving customer success and expanding Netcore's presence in the vibrant South American market. You'll be responsible for providing technical solutions and consulting services to prospective and existing customers, ensuring they derive maximum value from our CEE platform. This role offers high visibility, ample growth opportunities, and the chance to shape the future of customer engagement in South America.

  • Collaborate closely with sales, sales development and other cross-functional teams to craft tailored solutions that address customer needs and drive value.
  • Assist with product demonstrations, presentations, and workshops for new and existing customers to showcase the capabilities of Netcore's CEE platform, effectively communicating both technical and business benefits.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to customers, offering strategic guidance on leveraging Netcore's products to achieve their business goals and drive ROI.
  • Conduct deep discovery sessions with prospective and current customers in South America to understand their business objectives, technical requirements, and challenges.
  • Represent Netcore at industry events, conferences, and meetups in the South America region, building brand awareness and fostering relationships within the community.


What we are looking for?


  • Passionate and committed individuals with a customer-first mindset and a drive for delivering exceptional results.
  • 3-5 years of experience in a combination of sales engineering, solutions consulting, or customer success roles within the SaaS or MarTech industry.
  • Strong technical aptitude, with the ability to understand and articulate complex technical concepts in a clear and concise manner.
  • Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, with fluency in English and Portuguese (Spanish proficiency is a plus).
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment, supporting multiple stakeholders across different geographies.
  • Startup experience or familiarity with the startup culture is highly desirable.


Why Netcore?


Being first is in our nature. The first and leading AI/ML-powered marketing automation enabling better customer engagements for businesses of all sizes with cutting-edge technologies that include AI, automation, top-notch product experience, customer data platform, communication API and multi-channel client engagement options, - a comprehensive customer experience platform to enhance and exhilarate the client journey.

Netcore has a perfect combo of experience as well as an agile mind. We currently work with 5000+ enterprise brands across 18 countries and serve more than 70% Unicorns in India, making us among the top-rated customer engagement & experience platform.


Headquartered in Mumbai, we have our global footprints across 10 countries worldwide. Being certified as a Great Place to Work for three consecutive years only reinforces Netcore’s principle of being a people-centric company – where you will not be just an employee but a family member of the organisation.


A career at Netcore is more than just a job — it’s an opportunity to shape the future. For more information, please visit netcorecloud.Com or follow us on LinkedIn .


What’s in it for you?


  • Immense growth, continuous learning and consult the top-notch brands
  • Work with some of the most innovative brains
  • A fluid work environment
  • Opportunity to explore your entrepreneurial mind-set
  • Open culture where your creative bug gets activated.


If this sounds like a company you would like to be a part of, and a role you would thrive in, please don’t hold back from applying! We need your unique perspective for our continued innovation and success!

So let’s converse! Our inquisitive nature is all keen to know more about you.

title: Analista De Crédito E Cobrança (Tm Digital)
description:
Quem somos?

Com 8 anos de história, a TerraMagna vive a missão de tornar a agricultura tudo aquilo que o mundo precisa que ela seja. Hoje atua como financiadora da cadeia de insumos do agronegócio, visando seu sistema operacional e principal parceiro financeiro. Possui mais de 1 bilhão de reais sob gestão, captou 75 milhões de rodada em investimentos e atua com clientes em todo o Brasil.


A TM Digital é a divisão tecnológica da TerraMagna responsável por levar todas as nossas inovações para o mercado. Nossa jornada começou com a tecnologia, identificamos os desafios comuns do agronegócio e expandimos para o financiamento graças à nossa expertise em gestão de riscos em tempo real, um reflexo da nossa solidez tecnológica. Nosso propósito é fortalecer a cadeia de distribuição de insumos e transformar a maneira como o crédito é concedido e recebido no agronegócio brasileiro. Por isso, dividimos a credibilidade tecnológica que permitiu a TerraMagna se tornar o que é para o mercado agro.



Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Conduzir os processos de análise de crédito, por meio da verificação documental e avaliação criteriosa das informações, emitindo parecer técnico com aprovação, reprovação ou encaminhamento para instâncias superiores, conforme alçada estabelecida.
  • Fornecer informações completas e estruturadas à equipe comercial, filiais e instâncias superiores, assegurando embasamento sólido para decisões de crédito e cobrança assertivas.
  • Participar ativamente das negociações com clientes e time comercial, respeitando as diretrizes da política da companhia em termos de prazos, juros e condições, além de propor estruturas diferenciadas e personalizadas visando resolver conflitos e aumentar a rentabilidade das operações.
  • Executar o acompanhamento físico e remoto das garantias vinculadas às operações de crédito, reportando avanços e desvios ao Supervisor Regional conforme os parâmetros definidos.
  • Manter agenda contínua de visitas técnicas aos clientes para fortalecer o relacionamento, monitorar a evolução dos negócios e avaliar riscos locais, com produção de relatórios específicos sobre clientes e contexto da filial.
  • Atuar no acompanhamento e cobrança de clientes inadimplentes, conforme a régua definida pela Política de Crédito, além de manter relacionamento com tradings e armazéns terceiros responsáveis por produtos em garantia ou renegociados.
  • Consolidar e reportar ao Supervisor Regional os KPIs da filial conforme o cronograma definido pelo Gerente de Crédito, contribuindo para a gestão estratégica da área.
  • Realizar análise documental (CPRs, NPs, duplicatas, certidões, matrículas etc.), acompanhar a formalização das operações e monitorar a carteira para garantir o efetivo recebimento dos créditos.
  • Interagir com as áreas jurídica, comercial e de crédito e cobrança para desenvolver estratégias de mitigação de risco e soluções customizadas de crédito e cobrança, com foco na fidelização do cliente.
  • Acompanhar continuamente o lastro e os riscos vinculados às operações financeiras agrícolas, como CPRs e seguros, assegurando a integridade das garantias envolvidas.
  • Propor melhorias e desenvolver novas soluções de crédito e cobrança, contribuindo para o crescimento da companhia por meio da ampliação do portfólio e ações de cross-selling.
  • Atuar ativamente em comitês de crédito e cobrança, promovendo discussões técnicas e colaborativas com áreas internas e parceiros externos.



Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Graduação em Engenharia, Ciências Contábeis, Administração ou Ciências Econômicas ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência em análise de crédito e cobrança do agronegócio, especialmente operações de barter ;
  • Experiência comexecuções judiciais de garantias, especialmente arresto de penhor agrícola na safra;

  • Disponibilidadepara viagens de visitas a clientes e reuniões periódicas presenciais.

With over one hundred transactions in 2024, we’re looking for a top-performing business development professional to join Vela’s M&A deal origination team.
